 Fixed an issue where the game could not run properly in certain environments.

notes.notes:
[Bug fixes]

 Fixed an issue where monsters would fail to spawn correctly in special cases, causing them to gather in one spot.
 Various other minor bug fixes.

notes.notes:
Added visibility markers to the start and end points of each stage.

notes.title: WASD : The Adventure of Tori Update
notes.notes:
[Bug fixes]

 Fixed a bug where images would not appear when the key assignment roulette was running.
 Fixed a bug where the player voice volume slider would change values with user key inputs.

[UI]

 Now you can open or close the settings menu from the main scene using the ESC key.
 Added a popup to display when you are connecting/joining via Steam invite.
